description.narrative: Initiative targets a holistic digital transformation agenda that integrates Civil Registration and Vital Statistics (CRVS) with Digital Identity to guarantee legal identity for all, promote good governance, and address the gender divide by increasing digital literacy and inclusion. It emphasizes a whole-of-society approach, including government, private sector, and civil society, to foster economic growth and inclusivity.
